properties.summary: G7 Rapid Response Mechanism (Global Affairs Canada) reported on Russian state-aligned operations around Moldova's 2025 parliamentary elections, in joint G7 monitoring on 2026-04-17. State: quiet (no report from G7 Rapid Response Mechanism (Global Affairs Canada) in more than 180 days; not evidence the operation stopped). Activity the report covers: 2024-11 to 2025-10. Targets as entered from the report: Moldova. Operations Undertow tracks that the report names: Operation Overload, Portal Kombat, Storm-1516, Doppelganger. G7 Rapid Response Mechanism (Global Affairs Canada) describes it as aligned with Russia ("Russian state-aligned"); recorded as alignment, not as an origin. Undertow records that G7 Rapid Response Mechanism (Global Affairs Canada) reported the operation, not G7 Rapid Response Mechanism (Global Affairs Canada)'s attribution, so this item adds no origin and no confidence. G7 Rapid Response Mechanism (Global Affairs Canada) is a reporter, not the platform that acted (grade B2). A country named is not an origin, and an origin is never a finding of who directed it.
